<thought>Using the DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2 (oxygen does not affect DBE). For C18H13O2: DBE = (2*18 + 2 - 13)/2 = (36 + 2 - 13)/2 = 25/2 = 12.5. Since the required answer format is an integer, we round to the nearest whole number, giving 12.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
